rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for enclosing an object in paper, cloth, or similar material.

example.english: I wrap the present in paper.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zi2 baau1 zyu6 fan6 lai5 mat6

rows.note: Use this for the tortilla or pancake food filled with ingredients, usually as a meal or snack.

example.english: I had a chicken wrap for lunch.
example.traditional: 我午餐食咗個雞肉卷餅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ng5 caan1 sik6 zo2 go3 gai1 juk6 gyun2 beng2

rows.note: Use this when something coils tightly around and holds onto an object or animal.

example.english: The snake continues to wrap around the chicken and won't let go.
example.jyutping: tiu4 se4 cin4 zyu6 zek3 gai1 m4 fong3

rows.note: Use this for paper used to wrap, protect, contain, or conceal something.

example.english: This wrapping paper is thick enough to wrap the vase.
example.traditional: 呢張包裝紙夠厚，可以包住個花瓶。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 baau1 zong1 zi2 gau3 hau5 ho2 ji5 baau1 zyu6 go3 faa1 ping4

rows.note: Use this in computing or typography when text is moved onto the next line.

example.english: This bit of text is too long, so wrap it onto the next line to make it easier to read.
example.traditional: 呢段字太長，要換行先睇得清。
example.jyutping: nei1 dyun6 zi6 taai3 coeng4 jiu3 wun6 hong4 sin1 tai2 dak1 cing1

rows.note: Use this for the wrapping or packaging process itself rather than the material used.

example.english: I’ll wrap the gift myself; you don’t need to help.
example.traditional: 份禮物我自己包裝，唔使你幫手。
example.jyutping: fan6 lai5 mat6 ngo5 zi6 gei2 baau1 zong1 m4 sai2 nei5 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for the completion or final stage of filming a film or television production.

example.english: The production will wrap once we finish filming this scene.
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 hei3 paak3 maai4 zau6 saat3 fo1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for finishing the shooting of a video, television programme, or film.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 paak3 jyun4 bou6 hei3 laa3
